title: Content Access Control Decision Tree
purpose: Nine-decision-node content access pipeline from initial request through creator bypass, subscriber-only check, subscription validity, tier level, PPV flag, purchase verification, and watermark determination
description: Decision pipeline in content.service.ts:461-502. Starts with access request for content. Decision 1: Is viewer the creator? (Yes → full access, all restrictions bypassed). Decision 2: Is content subscribers_only? (No → check PPV flag). Decision 3: Is content PPV? (No → full access). Decision 4: Does fan have active subscription? (No → locked with subscribe prompt). Decision 5: Is min_tier_level set? (No → unlocked for subscriber). Decision 6: Does fan's subscription tier meet requirement? (No → locked with tier upgrade prompt). Decision 7: Is content also PPV? (for subscribers-only items that are also PPV). Decision 8: Has fan purchased this content? (merged from both PPV and subscriber+PPV paths; No → locked with PPV purchase prompt). Decision 9: Is content a photo? (Yes → unlocked with watermark overlay; No → fully unlocked). Seven terminal states: Full access, Locked-Subscribe, Unlocked-Subscriber, Locked-Tier, Locked-PPV, Unlocked-Watermark, Unlocked.

preconditions: Content exists and is not removed
Viewer is authenticated (for non-creator access checks)
Creator has configured subscription tiers if min_tier_level > 1
postconditions: Creator gets full-resolution content with no restrictions
Authorized fan receives content (possibly watermarked for photos)
Unauthorized fan sees locked placeholder with upgrade/purchase prompt
Access decision logged via analytics event

nodes.label: Access Request: viewer requests content
nodes.description: Viewer navigates to content URL or requests via API

nodes.label: Q1: Is viewer the creator?
nodes.description: Check if content.creator_id === viewer.id

nodes.label: FULL ACCESS (Creator bypass)
nodes.description: Creator sees own content with no restrictions, no watermark

nodes.label: Q2: Is content subscribers_only?
nodes.description: Check content.visibility === 'subscribers_only'

nodes.label: Q3: Is content PPV?
nodes.description: Check content.visibility === 'pay_per_view' or has price set

nodes.label: FULL ACCESS (Public content)
nodes.description: Content is public/non-gated — full access granted

nodes.label: Q4: Does fan have active subscription?
nodes.description: Query subscriptions table for active status fan->creator

nodes.label: LOCKED — Subscribe Prompt
nodes.description: Blurred preview shown, fan prompted to subscribe

nodes.label: Q5: Is min_tier_level set? (> 1)
nodes.description: Check if content.min_tier_level exists and > 1

nodes.label: UNLOCKED (Subscriber access granted)
nodes.description: Subscriber has access but may need watermark if also photo

nodes.label: Q6: Does fan's tier meet requirement?
nodes.description: Compare fan's subscription tier level against content.min_tier_level

nodes.label: LOCKED — Tier Upgrade Prompt
nodes.description: Current tier too low, fan prompted to upgrade

nodes.label: Q7: Is content PPV? (subscriber path)
nodes.description: Check if subscribers_only content also has PPV price set

nodes.label: Q8: Has fan purchased this content?
nodes.description: Query transactions for Cleared PPV type with this contentId

nodes.label: LOCKED — PPV Purchase Prompt
nodes.description: Blurred preview, fan prompted to purchase unlock

nodes.label: Q9: Is content a photo?
nodes.description: Check if content type is photo/image (not video or audio)

nodes.label: UNLOCKED (With Watermark Overlay)
nodes.description: Photo served with @username tiled watermark via dynamic sharp compositing

nodes.label: UNLOCKED (Full Content)
nodes.description: Non-photo content served at full resolution

nodes.label: END: Full Access
nodes.description: Terminal state for creator or public content access

nodes.label: END: Locked-Subscribe
nodes.description: Terminal state — subscribe prompt shown

nodes.label: END: Unlocked-Subscriber
nodes.description: Terminal state — subscriber granted access

nodes.label: END: Locked-Tier
nodes.description: Terminal state — tier upgrade prompt shown

nodes.label: END: Unlocked-Watermarked
nodes.description: Terminal state — watermarked photo delivered

nodes.label: END: Unlocked
nodes.description: Terminal state — full content delivered

nodes.label: END: Locked-PPV
nodes.description: Terminal state — PPV purchase prompt shown

decisions.truePath: FULL ACCESS — no restrictions, bypass all checks
Check if fan's tier meets requirement

decisions.condition: Does fan's subscription tier meet min_tier_level?
Has fan purchased this content (Cleared PPV transaction)?

errorPaths.recovery: Conservative fail — deny access instead of granting

errorPaths.trigger: Watermarking fails (sharp error, R2 download failure)

validationRules.rule: Tier meeting: fan's subscription tier level >= content.min_tier_level
PPV purchase: Cleared transaction with type PPV Post or PPV Message for contentId

businessRules.rule: Creator always gets full access — no checks applied
Subscription check requires status='active' — canceled does not grant access
CSS blur is client-side only — server never serves full content without access check
Watermark security degradation: if watermarking fails, original unwatermarked file served as fallback

securityConsiderations: CSS-blur bypass possible via browser DevTools — but server never serves full content without access check (mitigated)
Watermark security degradation: if watermarking fails, original unwatermarked file is served — degrades to unprotected access
No rate limiting on content access requests — potential for enumeration/scraping
Locked content returns placeholder URL — doesn't leak actual file location
Subscription status cached per request — no stale subscription expiry issue (no expiry mechanism exists)
performanceConsiderations: Each access check requires up to 3 DB queries (subscription, transaction, content)
Watermarking adds significant latency (R2 download + sharp compositing + R2 upload + signed URL)
No caching of access decisions — every view triggers full decision pipeline

annotations.text: Creator bypass — content.creator_id === viewer.id skips all 8 remaining decisions
CSS-blur on locked content is visual only — server never serves full content without access check
Watermark security degradation: if ANY watermarking step fails, original unwatermarked file is served as fallback
Seven terminal states: Full Access, Locked-Subscribe, Unlocked-Subscriber, Locked-Tier, Locked-PPV, Unlocked-Watermark, Unlocked
